text:
priya: Weird production hit: a customer reported dropped SSE events during long-lived streams. Console showed steady bytes_in but client missing every 60th event.

luis: Any pattern in sequence IDs or Last-Event-ID header?

priya: Yes. Client reconnects with Last-Event-ID=42 and receives 43..100 but every 60th (60,120,180) is missing. Server logs show we emitted them.

emma: Could be chunk coalescing at the proxy merging buffers and removing the empty-line separator between SSE events. If the double-newline is lost, the client treats two events as one.

priya: I grabbed a tcpdump around the proxy. Snippet:```
12:05:00.000 -> "data: {\"id\":59}\n\n"
12:05:00.120 -> "data: {\"id\":60}\n"
12:05:00.121 -> "data: {\"id\":61}\n\n"
```
Event 60 ends with a single \n, so coalesce can join it with 61 producing one combined event.

luis: We enabled proxy.chunk_coalesce=true in EU to reduce syscalls. Bug: coalesce merges buffers but doesn't ensure atomic double-newline between events when writers flush differently.

emma: Immediate mitigation: add a proxy rule that injects an extra \n when pattern `data:.*\ndata:` spans boundary. It's a short-lived patch while we roll back bad canaries.

priya: Agreed. Also add console telemetry: `sse_event_boundary_mutations` and `sse_boundary_sample` (redacted). Right now console shows bytes and connections only; operators couldn't see parse-level mutations.

luis: Make sure samples are redacted to avoid PII leaks; capture only id and sizes.

ops-bot: Canary rollback requested: proxy/coalesce -> rollback host group eu-1. Manual approval required.

priya: For long term: update SSE library to emit `\n\n` atomically for events and add unit tests that simulate TCP splits and coalescing. Also add an edge parser that validates egress framing and counts repairs.

emma: Console work: add a per-connection timeline marking "boundary repair" tick so operators can correlate with coalesce toggles and canaries.

luis: For the rollback, do a gradual scale down 30% -> 10% -> 0% to avoid noisy flips.

ops-bot: Rollback started: scale to 10% in eu-1. Monitor `sse_event_boundary_mutations`.

priya: Mutation count dropped from ~18/min -> ~1/min on canary hosts. Will open PRs: patch inject, SSE atomic-write, and console telemetry + runbook edits.

emma: Add unit test in proxy asserting that writes `write("data:..\n")` then `write("data:..")` result in `...\n\n` between events. Prevent regressions.

priya: Posting PR links when ready. Low-severity but high-impact for streaming UX; good catch. :heart:
